sections.content_text: Section 100 - Deduction from Insurance Commission A person responsible for payment of any amount for business related to continuation, renewal or revival of insurance policy including the business of solicitation or collection of insurance by way of commission or honorarium or reward in any other way while depositing the said sum or shall be deducted Tax at the rate of 5% (five percent) on the payment of the said amount by cash or check or draft or by any other means, whichever occurs earlier.
